title: Senior Relationship Manager
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our
**General Managament**
team at Marsh Risk India, a Marsh business. This role will be based in
**Gandhinagar - Gift City**
. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Senior Relationship Manager**
**We will count on you to:**
**Relationship Management:**
Build and maintain strong working relationships with existing clients, insurers, reinsurers, underwriters, and other market participants to ensure effective account servicing, client satisfaction, and retention of business.
  
  
**Documentation and Underwriting Submissions:**
Prepare and coordinate comprehensive underwriting submissions, risk information, placement slips, and other relevant documentation required for the evaluation and placement of insurance and reinsurance risks
**.
  
  
Risk Placement and Market Coordination:**
Facilitate the placement of reinsurance risks with appropriate and competitive markets, coordinating with insurers, reinsurers, and internal stakeholders to secure optimal terms and conditions for clients.
  
  
**Account Retention and Servicing:**
Proactively manage existing accounts, ensure timely renewals and follow-ups, address client requirements, and identify opportunities to strengthen business relationships and retain the existing portfolio.
  
  
**PEMA, Trade Credit, and Inward Transactions:**
Support the execution and servicing of PEMA, Trade Credit, Inward Reinsurance, and other permissible transactions within the scope of Marsh India’s GIFT City operations, subject to applicable IFSCA regulations and guidelines.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance and Administration:**
Ensure adherence to internal policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and IFSCA guidelines; maintain accurate transaction records and compliance documentation; and complete the necessary reporting, administrative, and operational activities within prescribed timelines.
  
  
**What you need to have:**

* 5-8 years of experience in insurance industry.
* Corporate Relationship Management / Business Solution Provider from a service background.
* Ability to manage diverse client cultures i.e. Indian Corporate, MNC Corporation and PSU clients.
* Required Domain knowledge

**What makes you stand out?**

* Proven Leadership skill traits (elected leader in community, school & college). Background of having leadership role.
* Exceptional selling & negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical skills, problem solving and decision making skills.
* Good networking skills and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, Public Oratory and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and within a team.
* Organised, self-discipline and pro-active.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Client Outreach Executive
description:
**Company Description**
RSE (Red Smile Entertainments) is a white-label post-production house specializing in wedding and corporate video editing for studios worldwide. Founded in 2018, the company has grown from a single editor to a dedicated team of 10 professionals serving clients across the UK, US, Canada, Australia, and the UAE. RSE works under strict NDAs, delivering all files under each client’s branding so that end viewers never know a third party was involved. The team manages wedding films, highlight reels, event coverage, and corporate videos, helping studios stay focused on production while RSE clears their editing backlog. RSE also offers free 30–60 second trial edits, giving potential partners a risk-free way to experience the service.

**Role Description:**
This is a full-time hybrid role for a Client Outreach Executive based in Gandhinagar, with flexibility for some work-from-home tasks. The Client Outreach Executive will engage with existing and prospective studio partners, introduce RSE’s post-production services, and coordinate trial edits and onboarding. Day-to-day responsibilities include responding to inquiries, scheduling and conducting calls or virtual meetings, understanding client requirements, and ensuring smooth handover of projects to the editing team. The role involves maintaining accurate records of interactions, following up on leads, gathering feedback from clients, and supporting long-term relationship building. Collaboration with the operations and editing teams will be essential to align client expectations with delivery timelines and service quality.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Communication and Customer Satisfaction skills to build trust, clarify requirements, and deliver a positive client experience.
* Account Management and Consulting abilities to understand studio workflows, recommend suitable services, and support ongoing client relationships.
* Sales skills to identify opportunities, present RSE’s value proposition, and convert leads into long-term partnerships.
* Comfort with digital tools (CRM, email, video conferencing) and basic understanding of video production or post-production workflows.
* Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Prior experience in client-facing roles in media, creative services, or B2B environments is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Presales Engineer
description:
**Job Title: PreSales Engineer**

**Shift Type: US Shift / Night Shift (7:30 PM to 4:30 AM IST)**

**Location:**
Mehsana, Gujarat

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, On-site

**Experience:**
0–3 years

**Department:**
Sales / Business Development

**Reporting To:**
Sales Team Leader / Business Development Manager

**About the Role:**

We are hiring a motivated
**Sales Development Representative (SDR)**
to join our growing sales team in Mehsana. In this role, you will contact potential customers through outbound calls, understand their requirements, explain our products/services at a high level, and identify genuinely interested prospects.

Once a lead shows interest or meets the qualification criteria, you will transfer the call to the senior sales leader or schedule a meeting with the concerned senior person. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates who want to build a career in sales, business development, and client communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers from provided lead lists, databases, and marketing campaigns.
* Contact inbound leads promptly and follow up consistently until the lead is qualified, converted, or closed.
* Introduce the company, products, and services clearly and professionally.
* Understand the prospect’s requirements, business needs, budget range, decision-making authority, and timeline.
* Qualify leads based on interest, fit, and readiness to speak with the senior sales team.
* Transfer interested and qualified leads to the Team Leader, Sales Manager, or relevant senior person through live call transfer.
* Schedule meetings, demos, or consultations between qualified prospects and senior team members.
* Send meeting confirmations, reminders, and required pre-meeting information to prospects.
* Maintain accurate and updated records of all calls, lead status, follow-ups, and outcomes in the CRM/Excel tracker.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets for calls, qualified leads, meetings scheduled, and conversions.
* Coordinate with the sales and marketing teams to improve lead quality and follow-up processes.
* Handle basic objections professionally and route complex queries to the senior team.
* Maintain a positive, professional, and customer-focused approach in every interaction.

**Requirements**

* Any graduate; candidates from sales, business development, customer support, telecalling, or lead generation backgrounds are preferred.
* 0–3 years of experience; freshers with strong communication skills may also apply.
* Excellent verbal communication skills in Gujarati, Hindi, and English.
* Confident telephone manner and ability to speak with customers professionally.
* Strong listening skills and ability to understand customer requirements.
* Basic knowledge of CRM software, Excel, Google Sheets, and lead-management tools is preferred.
* Ability to handle rejection positively and consistently follow up with leads.
* Good time management, discipline, and target-oriented mindset.
* Willingness to work from the Mehsana office.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed salary plus attractive performance incentives.
* Structured training on products, services, sales communication, and lead qualification.
* Clear career growth path toward Senior SDR, Business Development Executive, Sales Executive, or Team Leader roles.
* Supportive team environment and regular performance feedback.
* Opportunity to develop strong sales, communication, and client-handling skills.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Number of outbound calls made per day
* Number of leads contacted and followed up
* Number of qualified/interested leads identified
* Number of calls transferred to senior team members
* Number of meetings or demos scheduled
* Lead conversion and meeting-show-up rate
* Accuracy and timeliness of CRM/lead-status updates

title: Field Executive
description:
**Company Description**
ReAgri, a brand of NanoBee BioInnovations Pvt. Ltd., is a residue-free farming focused platform offering agri-inputs, agronomy services, and agri produce buyback through both online and offline channels. The company was founded to address the harmful impact of indiscriminate chemical pesticide and fungicide use on soil, the environment, and pest resistance. ReAgri provides farmers with guidance and solutions that enable residue-free farming and promote sustainable agricultural practices. Its products are designed to effectively manage soil issues, pests, and diseases while replacing synthetic and harmful chemical-based products. Leveraging extensive experience in residue-free farming methods, ReAgri is positioned to deliver an exclusive range of products and services tailored to the needs of the farming community.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Field Executive role based in Prantij. The Field Executive will interact directly with farmers and local partners to promote ReAgri’s residue-free farming products and services, conduct product demonstrations, and support adoption of sustainable agronomy practices. Responsibilities include visiting farms and local markets, explaining product benefits, collecting customer feedback, and ensuring timely follow-up on inquiries and orders. The role also involves coordinating small meetings or field days, maintaining accurate records of field activities, and reporting market trends and farmer needs to the central team. The Field Executive will collaborate with sales and agronomy teams to achieve growth targets while building long-term relationships with the farming community.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage with farmers, local dealers, and internal teams.
* Basic knowledge of agriculture, crop production, and sustainable or residue-free farming practices.
* Ability to conduct field visits, product demonstrations, and small group meetings in rural and semi-urban areas.
* Organizational and record-keeping skills for maintaining visit logs, customer data, and activity reports.
* Comfort with using smartphones or tablets for data entry, messaging apps, and basic digital tools.
* Proactive problem-solving attitude and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* Prior experience in field sales, agri-input marketing, or farmer outreach is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture or a related field preferred; candidates with strong relevant experience will also be considered.
* Ability to communicate in local languages of the Prantij region, along with basic English or Hindi, is beneficial.

**Business**
* Provide direct sales support to the RM on all origination activities for the assigned ARM client portfolio:

**Processes**

* Attend and minute Account Planning/Strategy ‘deep dive sessions’
* Work with the product partners to maximize cross\-sell and returns on risk weighted assets. Assist with deal returns calculations and pricing analysis wherever required
* Ensure all relevant client team members/internal stakeholders have been appropriately engaged by the Banker with respect to the planning and communication of the relevant approved strategy for each client
* In partnership with product partners, ensure appropriate line utilization of complex and structured transactions. Review client profitability data for clients and discuss opportunities/concerns with RM. Resolve any revenue/fee/returns recognition issues by engaging with internal stakeholders such as Finance, CPM, back office teams, etc.
* In partnership with the Banker, participate in conversations with clients to understand their needs and discuss the needs based account strategy and related opportunities, transactions, pricing issues etc
* Understand and be able to articulate the overall strategy for each client
* Support the RM through on\-going client engagement and vigilant monitoring of client performance with a deep understanding of the client’s overall industry business, performance and outlook.
* Support the RM with the proactive engagement and management of internal deal teams (all relevant product and functional partners) for complex transactions. Ensure all sensitive deal information is managed and treated confidentially
* As agreed with the RM, drive product and geography cross sell with clients
* Provide support to the RM with prompt logging of client calls into WorkBench (within 24 hours of the client meeting) and updating the deal pipeline. Support the RM to ensure client team activities required to accelerate deal conversion are followed up with the relevant internal stakeholders and with clients
* Provide support to the RM on exemplary deal management from origination to post deal ensuring at all times completion of relevant documentation, fulfilment of deal conditions and monitoring post fund disbursement


**Regulatory and Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.
